name: Love Amidst the Timeless Rift
source:
Time has frozen for everyone except our hero and his fellow guild members, all thanks to an enigmatic artifact.  Turns out, our villain has been kidnapping and brainwashing people to create a massive army for his grand castle renovation.

Yet, the solution is ... ENTERTAINING HIM AND CONFESSING YOUR SECRETS?!?! WITH YOUR GUILD MEMBERS?!?!

[Edited from [url=https://deniz-g-lerosi.itch.io/love-amidst-the-timeless-rift]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
除了我们的英雄和他的公会成员之外，每个人的时间都冻结了，这一切都归功于一件神秘的神器。事实证明，我们的恶棍一直在绑架和洗脑人们，为他的宏伟城堡整修建立一支庞大的军队。

然而，解决方案是……招待他并承认你的秘密？！？！与你的公会成员？！？！

[编辑自[url=https://deniz-g-lerosi.itch.io/love-amidst-the-timeless-rift]Itch.io[/url]]
